title: Jeep Gladiator Engines by Year
description: Every factory engine in the Jeep Gladiator pickup by year: the 1963–1971 Tornado six, 327 and Buick 350, and the 2020–2026 3.6 V6 and EcoDiesel.
intro: Jeep has sold two pickups called Gladiator: Kaiser's full-size truck of 1963–1971, which continued as the J-series, and the Wrangler-based Gladiator that arrived for 2020.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The first Gladiator shared the Wagoneer's engines: the Tornado six, then AMC's 232 six and the 327 Vigilante V8, Buick's 350 Dauntless V8, and AMC sixes and V8s from 1971.

generations.name: JT
intro: The Wrangler-based Gladiator uses the 3.6 Pentastar V6, with the 3.0 EcoDiesel offered for 2021–2023.

method: Every engine and year listed here was confirmed by at least three independent sources: the NHRA Stock Car Classification Guides, factory material such as GM Heritage Center information kits and sales brochures, EPA records and established references. Several Wikipedia articles count as one source. Where sources give different ratings, the factory figure is shown and the difference is noted. Factory race-only packages need two sources.
